# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We are committed to making participation in this project a respectful and harassment-free
experience for everyone.

## Expected behavior

Be constructive, assume good intent, respect differing viewpoints, and focus feedback on the work.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, intimidation, and publishing private information
without permission are not acceptable.

## Reporting

For urgent or sensitive concerns, contact the repository owner privately rather than opening a public
issue.
